ha.tasbeehDesigns.designs.pebbles.desc: Kowace ƙirga tana motsa ƙwallon dabino ko tsakuwa ɗaya daga kwano ɗaya zuwa ɗayan. Bayanin yana bayyana dalili da yadda malamai ke daraja shi.
ha.tasbeehDesigns.note.title: Game da wannan zane
ha.tasbeehDesigns.note.pebbles.body: Wani ruwaya ya ba da labarin wata mace da ke ƙirga tasbihinta da ƙwallon dabino ko tsakuwa a gaban Annabi ﷺ; ya koya mata kalmomi cikakku kuma ba a ruwaito cewa ya hana ba. Malamai sun bambanta wajen daraja wannan ruwaya. Da yawa sun halatta ƙirga da tsakuwa, ƙwallon dabino ko carbi, yayin da wasu ke ganin ƙirga da ƙarshen yatsu ya fi. Kowane zane yana ƙirga daidai iri ɗaya.

ha.khatmGroups.grid.hint.self_pick: Taɓa sashe a buɗe don ɗauka.
ha.khatmGroups.grid.hint.round_robin: A farkon kowane zagaye, ana raba sassa bi da bi ga membobi. Kowa zai iya mayar da sashe don wasu su ɗauka.
ha.khatmGroups.grid.hint.creator_assigns: Masu shiryawa ne ke raba kowane sashe.
ha.khatmGroups.grid.legend: Layi-layi = a buɗe · toka = an ɗauka · mai launi = ana karantawa · ✓ = an gama. Ƙaramin ɗigo yana nuna sashen da aka daɗe ba aiki.
ha.khatmGroups.sheet.doneNote: An karanta wannan sashe. Allah Ya karɓa.
ha.khatmGroups.sheet.noActions: Babu abin yi a nan yanzu.
ha.khatmGroups.sheet.staleMine: Babu gaggawa — idan ba za ka iya gama shi ba, za ka iya mayar da shi don wani ya karanta.
ha.khatmGroups.sheet.askFirst: Wataƙila {{name}} har yanzu yana karanta wannan sashe. Da fatan ka tambaye su tukuna kafin ka ba wani.
ha.khatmGroups.sheet.returnToPool: Mayar da shi cikin sassan da ke a buɗe
ha.khatmGroups.toast.completed: An yi alamar an gama. Allah Ya karɓa.
ha.khatmGroups.error.conflict: Wani ya canza wannan sashe yanzu — an sabunta jadawalin.
ha.khatmGroups.error.gone: Wannan gayyata ta ƙare ko an gama amfani da ita.
ha.khatmGroups.error.notFound: Wannan rukuni ko sauka ba ya samuwa yanzu.
ha.khatmGroups.error.forbidden: Masu shiryawa kawai ke iya yin hakan.
ha.khatmGroups.error.rateLimited: Gwaji ya yi yawa — da fatan a jira ɗan lokaci.
ha.khatmGroups.error.offline: Ba ka kan layi. Da fatan a sake gwadawa idan ka haɗu.
ha.khatmGroups.error.unknown: Hakan bai yi nasara ba. Da fatan a sake gwadawa.
ha.khatmGroups.myParts.title: Sassana
ha.khatmGroups.deadline.decisionBody: Wasu sassa ba a gama su ba tukuna. Za ka iya ba kowa ƙarin lokaci, ko ka buɗe sassan da ba a gama ba domin kowa ya ɗauke su.
ha.khatmGroups.deadline.opened: Sassan da ba a gama ba a buɗe suke ga kowa
ha.khatmGroups.complete.title: Alhamdulillah — an kammala saukar
ha.khatmGroups.complete.body: An karanta kowane sashe. Ɗauki ɗan lokaci cikin natsuwa don addu'a, gare ku da kuma waɗanda kuka yi niyya.
ha.khatmGroups.share.message: Muna sauke Alƙur'ani tare a Munib Tracker.
ha.khatmGroups.share.error: Ba a iya shirya katin rabawa ba.
ha.khatmGroups.invite.title: Gayyaci mutane
ha.khatmGroups.invite.hint: Duk wanda ke da hanyar haɗi zai iya shiga — ko babu asusu. Gayyatar sauka tana aiki ga mutane har 200 kuma tana ƙarewa cikin kwanaki 7.
ha.khatmGroups.intentionNote.title: Game da niyya
ha.khatmGroups.intentionNote.body: Za ka iya rubuta niyya, kamar Ramadan ko wani masoyi da ya rasu. Malamai sun bambanta game da kyautar ladan karatu ga mamaci; manhajar ba ta ɗauki kowane gefe ba.
ha.khatmGroups.create.screenSubtitle: Raba Alƙur'ani sassa-sassa kuma ku sauke shi tare.
ha.khatmGroups.create.title: Taken sauka
ha.khatmGroups.create.intentionHint: Membobin wannan rukunin suna iya gani.
ha.khatmGroups.create.tagMasjidHint: Yana nuna {{name}} a rukunin — don nuni kawai.
ha.khatmGroups.create.tv: Fara saukar rukuni daga wayarka; za ka iya bin ta a nan.
ha.khatmGroups.searchKeywords: saukar rukuni, sauka, khatm, khatam, sauke Alƙur'ani tare, izu, juz, hizbi, sura
ha.khatmGroups.deal.hint: Ana raba sassa bi da bi da zarar akwai aƙalla mutane biyu a rukunin, kuma a sake raba su idan sabon mutum ya shiga. Kowa zai iya mayar da sashe don wasu su ɗauka.
ha.khatmGroups.deal.body: Wasu sassa da babu wanda ya fara su tukuna za a iya raba su daidai. Sassan da ake karantawa ko aka gama suna nan a inda suke.
ha.khatmGroups.deal.waiting: Sassa suna a buɗe har sai wani ya shiga — sannan a raba su bi da bi. Gayyaci mutane a ƙasa.
ha.coach.title: Tunani na mako-mako
ha.coach.subtitle: Wasu ƙananan matakai masu kyau daga makonka — an lissafa su a wannan na'urar.
ha.coach.privacy: An lissafa a wannan na'urar daga bin diddiginka. Ba a aika komai ko'ina ba, kuma littattafan sirri suna raba adadi kawai.
ha.coach.disclaimer: Don tambayoyi game da halin da kake ciki, tuntuɓi malami ƙwararre.

ha.coach.quiet.title: Sabon mako
ha.coach.quiet.body: Ba a bi diddigin komai a wannan mako ba — kuma hakan ba laifi. Duk lokacin da ka shirya, fara da sallah ɗaya.
ha.coach.hiddenToast: An ɓoye. Za ka iya dawo da shawarwarin da aka ɓoye a ƙasan wannan shafi.
ha.coach.restoreHidden: Sake nuna shawarwarin da aka ɓoye
ha.coach.snoozedToast: Katin zai dawo tare da tunanin mako mai zuwa.
ha.coach.goal.title: Ƙaramar manufa don wannan mako
ha.coach.goal.accepted: An saita manufa — za mu duba ta tare ranar {{date}}, in sha Allah.
ha.coach.goal.last.title: Manufar makon da ya gabata
ha.coach.goal.last.progress: Ka kai {{value}} cikin {{target}} — kowane mataki yana da daraja. Ci gaba, kuma ka roƙi Allah Ya sauƙaƙa.
ha.coach.goal.kind.fard_days: Duka biyar a kan lokaci — kwanaki {{target}} cikin 7
ha.coach.goal.kind.fajr_sunnah_days: Raka'o'i biyu kafin Fajr — kwanaki {{target}} cikin 7
ha.coach.goal.kind.adhkar_days: Azkar na safe ko yamma — kwanaki {{target}} cikin 7
ha.coach.goal.kind.masjid_salah: Sallah cikin jam'i a wannan mako: {{target}}
ha.coach.goal.kind.qaza_week: Qaza da aka rama a wannan mako: {{target}}
ha.coach.goal.kind.family_contact: Kira, ziyara ko saƙonni ga iyali a wannan mako: {{target}}
ha.coach.rule.excused_week.title: Huta ka dawo
ha.coach.rule.excused_week.body.hayd: Jerin kwanakinka yana nan lafiya. Huta ba tare da laifi ba — zikiri da addu'a a buɗe suke gare ki duk lokacin da kika so.
ha.coach.rule.excused_week.body.nifas: Jerin kwanakinka yana nan lafiya. Huta ki murmure — zikiri da addu'a a buɗe suke gare ki duk lokacin da kika so.
ha.coach.rule.excused_week.body.sick: Jerin kwanakinka yana nan lafiya. Huta ka murmure, ka yi sallah gwargwadon ikonka. Ladan abin da kake yi lokacin lafiya yana ci gaba, in sha Allah.
ha.coach.rule.excused_week.body.travel: Jerin kwanakinka yana nan lafiya. Ka yi tafiya lafiya — ladan abin da kake yi a gida yana ci gaba, in sha Allah. Ra'ayin mazhabarka game da taƙaita sallah yana cikin jagorar tafiya.
ha.coach.rule.excused_week.body.generic: Jerin kwanakinka yana nan lafiya. Huta, ka dawo duk lokacin da ka shirya.
ha.coach.rule.personal_best.title: Sabon babban matsayinka
ha.coach.rule.personal_best.body: Mafi tsawon jerin sallarka zuwa yanzu: kwanaki {{days}}. Alhamdulillah — abin da ka yi yana tare da kai.
ha.coach.rule.improvement.title: Ana ci gaba, Alhamdulillah
ha.coach.rule.improvement.body.fard: Sallah a kan lokaci a wannan mako: {{done}} cikin {{total}} — fiye da makonnin baya. Ka riƙe shi ƙarami kuma a tsaye.
ha.coach.rule.improvement.body.rawatib: Sunnah rawatib a wannan mako: {{done}} cikin {{total}} — fiye da makonnin baya. Ka riƙe shi ƙarami kuma a tsaye.
ha.coach.rule.improvement.body.quran: Kwanaki da Alƙur'ani: {{done}} cikin {{total}} — fiye da makonnin baya. Ka riƙe shi ƙarami kuma a tsaye.
ha.coach.rule.improvement.body.adhkar: Kwanaki da azkar na safe ko yamma: {{done}} cikin {{total}} — fiye da makonnin baya. Ka riƙe shi ƙarami kuma a tsaye.
ha.coach.rule.quran_streak.title: Kusa da Alƙur'ani
ha.coach.rule.quran_streak.body: Ka ba da lokaci ga Alƙur'ani a kwanaki {{done}} cikin 7. Allah Ya sanya shi haske gare ka.
ha.coach.rule.habit_consistent.title: Ɗabi'u masu dorewa
ha.coach.rule.habit_consistent.body.one: Ka kiyaye “{{habit}}” kowace rana a wannan mako.
ha.coach.rule.habit_consistent.body.many: Ɗabi'un da ka kiyaye kowace rana a wannan mako: {{done}}.
ha.coach.rule.adhkar_steady.title: Tunawa da Allah
ha.coach.rule.adhkar_steady.body: Azkar na safe ko yamma a kwanaki {{done}} cikin 7. Kyakkyawar hanya ce ta fara da ƙare rana.
ha.coach.rule.fasting_kept.title: Azumin nafila
ha.coach.rule.fasting_kept.body: Azumin nafila da ka yi a wannan mako: {{done}}. Allah Ya karɓa daga gare ka.
ha.coach.rule.muhasabah_steady.title: Yin lissafin kai
ha.coach.rule.muhasabah_steady.body: Daren da ka tsaya don yin tunani a wannan mako: {{done}}.
ha.coach.rule.showed_up.title: Ka bayyana
ha.coach.rule.showed_up.body: Ka bi diddigin ibadarka a kwanaki {{done}} cikin 7. Kowane ƙaramin mataki yana da daraja.
ha.coach.rule.fajr_gap.title: Sauƙaƙa Fajr
ha.coach.rule.fajr_gap.body.noBedtime: Fajr a kan lokaci: kwanaki {{done}} cikin {{total}}, yayin da sauran sallolinka suka fi tsayawa. Yin barci da wuri kaɗan da karanta azkar kafin barci na iya taimakawa.
ha.coach.rule.fajr_gap.body.bedtime: Fajr a kan lokaci: kwanaki {{done}} cikin {{total}}, yayin da sauran sallolinka suka fi tsayawa. Yin barci kaɗan kafin {{bedtime}} da karanta azkar kafin barci na iya taimakawa.
ha.coach.rule.delayed_pattern.title: Sauƙaƙa {{prayer}}
ha.coach.rule.delayed_pattern.body: {{prayer}} ta zo a makare fiye da yadda kake so a kwanaki {{done}} a wannan mako. Tunatarwa da wuri na iya taimakawa.
ha.coach.rule.weekday_dip.title: Tsari don {{weekday}}
ha.coach.rule.weekday_dip.body: Tsawon makonni uku, {{weekday}} ta kasance rana mafi wahala ga sallah a kan lokaci. Ƙaramin tsari don wannan rana — tunatarwa, ko sanin inda za ka yi sallah — zai iya sauƙaƙa ta.
ha.coach.rule.family_ties_due.title: Zumunci
ha.coach.rule.family_ties_due.body: Mahaifi ko mahaifiya za su so jin labarinka a wannan mako.
ha.coach.rule.khatm_behind.title: Tsarin saukarka
ha.coach.rule.khatm_behind.body: Tsarinka ya wuce karatunka da kusan kwanaki {{days}}. Tafiya a hankali ma tana kai wa sauka — za ka iya daidaita tsarin kowane lokaci.
ha.coach.rule.qaza_pace.title: Tsarin qaza naka
ha.coach.rule.qaza_pace.body.pace: Qaza da ya rage: {{remaining}}. A saurinka na yanzu za ka gama kusan {{date}} — ƙarin ɗaya a rana zai kawo shi kusan kwanaki {{sooner}} da wuri.
ha.coach.rule.qaza_pace.body.start: Qaza da ya rage: {{remaining}}. Ko ɗaya a rana yana taruwa — rama su a hankali, kuma ka roƙi Allah gafara kan abin da aka rasa.
ha.coach.rule.khushu_low_prayer.title: Halartar zuciya a {{prayer}}
ha.coach.rule.khushu_low_prayer.body: Mayar da hankali a {{prayer}} ya fi wahala kwanan nan. Koyon ma'anar abin da kake karantawa na iya taimaka wa zuciya ta halarta.
ha.coach.rule.rawatib_start.title: Mataki na gaba: sunnah
ha.coach.rule.rawatib_start.body: Sallolin farillanka sun tsaya a wannan mako — Alhamdulillah. Kyakkyawan mataki na gaba shi ne raka'o'i biyu kafin Fajr.
ha.coach.rule.jama_rate.title: Masallacinka
ha.coach.rule.jama_rate.body: Shin sallah ɗaya a wannan mako za ta iya kasancewa cikin jam'i a masallacinka?
ha.coach.rule.focus_emergency.title: Kullen mayar da hankalinka a wannan mako
ha.coach.rule.focus_emergency.body: An yi amfani da buɗewar gaggawa sau {{done}} a wannan mako. Wannan ƙididdiga ce kawai, kuma wasu kwanaki suna buƙatarta. Idan lokutan sallah ko yanayin buɗewa ba su dace da tsarinka ba, kana iya daidaita su.
ha.coach.home.title: Tunaninka na mako-mako
ha.coach.home.body: A shirye: wasu matakai masu kyau daga makonka
ha.coach.home.bodyExcused: Huta ka dawo — jerin kwanakinka yana nan lafiya
ha.coach.notif.title: Tunani na mako-mako
ha.coach.settings.title: Tunatarwa
ha.coach.settings.notifHint: Sanarwa ɗaya a hankali idan tunaninka ya shirya — babu bayanai a allon kulle.
ha.coach.settings.dayHint: Juma'a bayan sallar Juma'a ta asali.

ha.family.title: Iyali
ha.family.subtitle: Taimaka wa yaranka su saba da sallah, a hankali
ha.family.searchKeywords: iyali yara ɗa mahaifi yanayin yara koyar da sallah lada lambobin yabo taurari family kids
ha.family.tvSetup: Saita da'irar iyalinka a wayarka. Wannan allon don kallo ne kawai a TV.
ha.family.create.title: Fara da'irar iyalinka
ha.family.create.body: Kai ne mahaifin da zai kula da ita. Za ka iya gayyatar ɗaya mahaifin kuma ka ƙara yaranka daga baya.
ha.family.create.name: Sunan da'ira
ha.family.noChildren: Babu bayanan yaro tukuna. Ƙara yaro don farawa.
ha.family.shareMine: Raba matsayin sallar farillata da iyayena
ha.family.shareMineHint: ✓ / – kawai ga sallolin farilla biyar. A kashe ta asali; za ka iya kashe shi kowane lokaci.
ha.family.leaveConfirmTitle: Za ka bar wannan da'irar iyali?
ha.family.leaveConfirmBody: Za ka daina ganin wannan da'irar nan take. Duk abin da ka raba za a cire shi bayan kwanaki 30.
ha.family.deleteConfirmTitle: Za ka goge wannan da'irar iyali?
ha.family.deleteConfirmBody: Wannan yana goge da'irar, kowane bayanin yaro da duk matsayin da aka raba yanzu. Ba za a iya dawo da shi ba.
ha.family.restDayHint: Yi alamar ranar hutu duk lokacin da yaronka ke buƙatar hutu — ba a taɓa rubuta dalili ba.
ha.family.stickersA11y: Lambobin yabo da aka samu a wannan mako
ha.family.digest: {{name}} ya yi sallah {{prayed}} cikin {{possible}} a wannan mako — mashaAllah.
ha.family.digestEmpty: Ba a rubuta komai ba tukuna a wannan mako — kowane ƙaramin mataki yana da daraja.
ha.family.digestLearning: Yanayin koyo: babu abin da ake tsammani tukuna — kowace sallah da aka gwada mataki ce.
ha.family.bandHint.learning: Ƙasa da 7: yanayin koyo. Ana iya rubuta sallah don aiki, ba tare da tsammani ba.
ha.family.bandHint.gentle: 7 zuwa 12: bin diddigi a hankali da taurari da lambobin yabo.
ha.family.bandHint.graduate: 13 ko sama da haka: ba a amfani da yanayin yara — gayyace su da asusunsu maimakon haka.
ha.family.privacy.title: Abin da iyaye ke gani
ha.family.privacy.body: Ga kowane yaro, ko an rubuta kowace daga cikin sallolin farilla biyar (✓ / –) da lambobin yabon yaron kawai. Babu bayanai, babu qaza, babu matsayi, kuma babu kwatanta tsakanin yara. Ba a taɓa raba sallar mahaifi ba.
ha.family.evidence.title: Me yasa iyali ke sallah tare
ha.family.evidence.q666: Qur'an 66:6 — ku kare kanku da iyalanku
ha.family.evidence.q20132: Qur'an 20:132 — umurci iyalinka da sallah kuma ka yi haƙuri a kanta
ha.family.add.title: Ƙara yaro
ha.family.add.nicknameHint: Suna na farko ko laƙabi. Ba a buƙatar sunan iyali.
ha.family.add.birthYearHint: Shekara kawai ake adanawa — ba ranar haihuwa ba.
ha.family.add.error: Ba a iya ƙara bayanin yaron ba. Da fatan a sake gwadawa.
ha.family.consent.title: Izinin iyaye
ha.family.consent.stored: Muna adana laƙabi da shekarar haihuwa da ka shigar kawai, da sallar da yaronka ya rubuta (✓ / –).
ha.family.consent.visible: Iyaye a wannan da'irar iyali kawai ke iya ganin matsayin yaronka. Ba a raba komai da sauran yara.
ha.family.consent.device: Na'urar yaronka ba ta buƙatar imel ko kalmar sirri, kuma za ka iya cire haɗinta kowane lokaci.
ha.family.consent.delete: Za ka iya goge bayanin da duk bayanansa kowane lokaci.
ha.family.consent.confirm: Ni ne mahaifi ko mai kula da wannan yaron kuma na yarda
ha.family.reconsent.title: Da fatan ka tabbatar da izini
ha.family.reconsent.body: Mahaifin da ya ƙirƙiri waɗannan bayanan yara ya rufe asusunsa, don haka bayanan sun koma gare ka: {{names}}. Da fatan ka tabbatar da izinin iyaye don ajiye su, ko ka goge su.
ha.family.reconsent.deadline_one: Idan ba ka tabbatar ba, za a goge su cikin rana {{count}}.
ha.family.reconsent.deadline_other: Idan ba ka tabbatar ba, za a goge su cikin kwanaki {{count}}.
ha.family.reconsent.confirmed: Na gode — an tabbatar da izini
ha.family.child.title: Yaro
ha.family.child.notFound: Ba a sami bayanin wannan yaron ba.
ha.family.child.deleteTitle: Za ka goge bayanin wannan yaron?
ha.family.child.deleteBody: Ana goge bayanin, matsayinsa, lambobin yabo da na'urar da aka haɗa nan take. Ba za a iya dawo da shi ba.
ha.family.device.title: Na'urar yaro
ha.family.device.body: Nuna wannan lambar QR ga wayar ko kwamfutar hannu ta yaronka. Kyamararsu tana buɗe manhajar a yanayin yara — babu imel ko kalmar sirri.
ha.family.device.linked: An haɗa na'ura. Sake haɗawa yana maye gurbinta.
ha.family.device.qrHint: Tana aiki na mintuna 5 kuma sau ɗaya.
ha.family.device.qrA11y: Lambar QR don haɗa na'urar yaronka
ha.family.reward.title: Lada
ha.family.reward.body: Saita lada ta gaske da yaronka ke ƙoƙarin samu, kamar ziyarar wurin shakatawa. Ci gaba yana ƙirga kwanaki da aka rubuta duka biyar — ranar da aka rasa ba ta sake saita shi.
ha.family.graduation.title: Girma
ha.family.graduation.body: Kusan shekara 13 yaronka zai iya komawa asusunsa. Balaga ita ce ainihin alama, don haka za ka iya ba da izini da wuri. Bayan sun koma, ba za ka ƙara ganin matsayinsu ba sai idan sun zaɓi rabawa.
ha.family.graduation.early: Ba da izinin komawa asusunsu yanzu
ha.family.graduation.reprompt: An sake bayarwa: a shirye don komawa asusunsu. Mazhabobi sun bambanta game da shekarun balaga; alamominta ne ainihin abin dubawa.
ha.family.invite.title: Gayyata zuwa iyalinka
ha.family.invite.subtitle: Kowace lamba tana aiki sau ɗaya kuma tana ƙarewa bayan kwanaki 7
ha.family.invite.parentHint: Za su iya sarrafa bayanan yara tare da kai.
ha.family.invite.memberHint: Suna shiga da asusunsu kuma ba sa raba komai sai idan sun zaɓa.
ha.kids.title: Yanayin yara
ha.kids.tvUnavailable: Yanayin yara yana aiki a waya ko kwamfutar hannu.
ha.kids.notLinked: Ba a haɗa wannan na'urar da bayanin yaro ba tukuna.
ha.kids.pray.hint: Taɓa sallah idan ka yi ta.
ha.kids.pray.learningHint: Lokacin aiki! Taɓa sallah idan ka gwada ta.
ha.kids.pray.allFive: Duka biyar yau — ka sami lambar yabo!
ha.kids.unlinkBody: Yanayin yara zai kashe a wannan na'urar. Mahaifi zai iya sake haɗa ta da sabuwar lambar QR.
ha.kids.graduate.offer: Kana girma! Za ka iya komawa asusunka.

ha.kids.graduate.subtitle: Ka riƙe wurinka a da'irar iyali
ha.kids.graduate.notYet: Komawa asusunka ba ya samuwa tukuna. Tambayi mahaifinka.
ha.kids.graduate.signIn: Shiga da asusunka don ci gaba.
ha.kids.graduate.privacy: Bayan ka koma, iyayenka ba za su ƙara ganin sallarka ba sai idan ka kunna rabawa.
ha.kids.graduate.reprompt: Za ka iya komawa asusunka duk lokacin da ka shirya. Mazhabobi sun bambanta game da shekarun balaga; alamominta ne ainihin abin dubawa.
ha.kids.link.title: Haɗa da bayanin yaro
ha.kids.link.subtitle: Don wayar ko kwamfutar hannu ta yaro
ha.kids.link.howTo: Tambayi mahaifinka ya buɗe Iyali › Sarrafa › Nuna lambar QR, sannan ka duba ta da kyamarar wannan na'urar. Ko liƙa lambar a nan.
ha.kids.link.error: Wannan lambar ba ta yi aiki ba. Tana ɗaukar mintuna 5 kuma tana aiki sau ɗaya — nemi sabuwa.
ha.kids.link.rateLimited: Gwaji ya yi yawa. Da fatan a jira 'yan mintuna.
ha.kids.link.already: An riga an haɗa wannan na'urar da bayanin yaro.
ha.kids.link.privacy: Ba a amfani da imel ko kalmar sirri. Mahaifi zai iya cire haɗin wannan na'urar kowane lokaci.
ha.kids.salahPath.title: Hanyar sallah
ha.kids.salahPath.intro: Koye ta mataki-mataki: na farko alwala, sannan Sallolin yau da kullum biyar, sannan yadda ake sallah.
ha.kids.prophets.title: Labaran annabawa
ha.kids.prophets.intro: Karanta game da annabawan da Allah Ya aiko don shiryar da mutane.
ha.kids.prophets.notFound: Wannan labarin ba ya cikin yanayin yara.

ha.kids.consentPending.body: Ci gaba da taɓa Sallarka kamar yadda aka saba. Ana ajiye taɓawarka a wannan na'urar kuma za a raba su da zarar mahaifinka ya amince.
ha.preferredTimeReminder.title: Lokacin da aka fi so na {{prayer}}

ha.preferredTimeReminder.settingTitle: Tunatar da ni a lokacin da aka fi so
ha.preferredTimeReminder.settingSub: Ƙarin tunatarwa ɗaya lokacin da lokacin da mazhabarka ta fi so na Fajr, Asr ko Isha ya fara (inda ya bambanta da farko). Lokutan na kusan-kusa ne.

ha.timetableImport.title: Shigo da jadawali
ha.timetableImport.subtitle: Ɗauki hoton jadawalin da aka buga na masallacinka kuma ka duba lokutan kafin adanawa.
ha.timetableImport.tvNote: Shigo da jadawali daga manhajar a wayarka. Lokutanka za su bayyana a nan ma.
ha.timetableImport.unavailableTitle: Karanta rubutu ba ya samuwa a nan
ha.timetableImport.unavailableBody: Wannan sigar manhajar ba za ta iya karanta hotuna a wannan na'urar ba. Har yanzu za ka iya rubuta lokutan masallacinka.
ha.timetableImport.onDevice: Ana sarrafawa a wayarka — ba a taɓa loda hoton ba
ha.timetableImport.inBrowser: Ana sarrafawa a wannan burauzar — ba a taɓa loda hoton ba
ha.timetableImport.reviewSummary: An sami lokutan iqama {{filled}} · {{check}} don dubawa
ha.timetableImport.reviewHint: Akwatunan da aka haskaka sun yi wuyar karantawa ko suna da ban mamaki ga wurinka. Gyara duk abin da ba daidai ba, ko share akwati don barin shi.
ha.timetableImport.monthTitle: Wannan takarda ta wane wata ce?
ha.timetableImport.outOfMonth: Wasu layuka sun wuce ƙarshen wannan wata kuma ba za a adana su ba. Duba watan.

ha.timetableImport.fixInvalid_other: Lokuta {{count}} ba su kasance a tsarin HH:MM ba tukuna.
ha.timetableImport.emptyBody: Ba mu iya samun sunayen Sallah da lokuta a wannan hoton ba. Gwada hoto mai kyau, kai tsaye na teburin kawai, ko rubuta lokutan.
ha.timetableImport.errorTitle: Ba a iya karanta hoton ba
ha.timetableImport.errorBody: Wani abu ya faru yayin karanta hoton. Sake gwadawa, ko rubuta lokutan.
ha.timetableImport.intro: Shigo da lokutan iqama na {{name}} daga allon yau da kullum da aka buga ko takardar wata.
ha.timetableImport.tips: Shimfiɗa takardar a kwance, cika firam da teburin, kuma ka guji haske mai ƙyalli. Yanke zuwa teburin idan za ka iya.
ha.timetableImport.webDownload: A karon farko, burauzarka tana sauke kusan {{size}} MB na bayanan karanta rubutu daga jsDelivr (CDN na jama'a). Bayanan kawai ake saukewa — hotonka yana zama a wannan burauzar.
ha.timetableImport.webCached: An riga an adana bayanan karanta rubutu a wannan burauzar.
ha.timetableImport.keepPhoto: Ajiye hoton yayin da nake dubawa
ha.timetableImport.keepPhotoHint: Yana nuna hoton kusa da lokutan. Ana goge shi idan ka adana ko ka fita.
ha.timetableImport.cameraDenied: Samun damar kyamara a kashe yake. Kunna shi a Saituna, ko zaɓi hoto maimakon haka.
ha.timetableImport.privacy: Lokutan da ka shigo da su ana adana su a matsayin Lokutanka na masallacinka: na sirri ga na'urorinka, ba a taɓa raba su da sauran masu amfani ba.
ha.timetableImport.nothingToSave: Babu lokutan iqama da za a adana tukuna.
ha.timetableImport.invalidHint: Rubuta lokacin a matsayin HH:MM, misali 13:30.
ha.timetableImport.flag.farFromCalculated: Ya yi nisa da lokacin da aka lissafa
ha.timetableImport.flag.iqamahWindow: Tazara mai ban mamaki bayan kiran sallah
ha.timetableImport.flag.missing: Ba a samu a takardar ba
ha.timetableImport.flag.columnUnclear: Kan shafi bai bayyana ba — duba wace Sallah ce wannan
ha.timetableImport.beginsOnly: Wannan takardar tana lissafa lokutan farawa (kiran sallah) kawai, don haka ba a ɗauki lokutan iqama daga gare ta ba. Rubuta lokutan iqama na masallacinka a ƙasa.
ha.timetableImport.monthWrap: Wannan takardar ta shiga wata mai zuwa. Duba cewa watan da ke sama shi ne watan da takardar ta fara.
ha.timetableImport.dateColumnBody: Wannan takardar tana da shafi fiye da ɗaya na lambobin rana. Zaɓi wanda ke da ranar wata — ba ranar Ramadan ko ta Hijira ba.

ha.masjidLog.tahiyyatBody: Idan an shiga masallaci, Sunnah ita ce yin raka'o'i biyu kafin a zauna: tahiyyat al-masjid, gaisuwar masallaci.
ha.masjidLog.tahiyyatNextIqamah: Iqama ta gaba a masallacinka: {{prayer}} da {{time}}. Isowa 'yan mintuna da wuri yana ba da lokaci ga waɗannan raka'o'i biyu.
ha.settingsGaps.onboarding.setupHint: Wasu abubuwa ba a saita su ba tukuna. Yi su yanzu ko kowane lokaci daga Saituna.
ha.quranPronunciation.title: Duba furuci
ha.quranPronunciation.intro: Karanta ayar da ke kan allo da ƙarfi, sannan ka taɓa An gama. Kowace kalma tana dawowa a matsayin A bayyane, Sake saurare ko Ban tabbata ba. Komai yana zama a na'urarka.
ha.quranPronunciation.listening: Ana saurare… karanta a hankalinka, sannan ka taɓa An gama.
ha.quranPronunciation.unavailable: Duba furuci ba ya samuwa a wannan na'urar.
ha.quranPronunciation.micDenied: Makirufo a kashe yake ga wannan manhaja. Kunna shi a Saituna don duba karatunka.
ha.quranPronunciation.word.skippedOrUnclear: An tsallake ko bai bayyana ba
ha.quranPronunciation.result.headClear: Babu abin da za a sake saurare a wannan aya
ha.quranPronunciation.result.listenHint: Waɗannan kalmomi ba su fito a bayyane ba. Taɓa ɗaya don jin mai karatu, sannan ka sake karanta ayar.
ha.quranPronunciation.result.skippedHint: Waɗannan kalmomi sun yi kamar an tsallake su ko ba su bayyana ba. Taɓa ɗaya don jin mai karatu, sannan ka sake karanta ayar.
ha.quranPronunciation.result.notSureNote: Kalmomin da aka yi wa alamar Ban tabbata ba ba za a iya yanke hukunci a kansu ba — hakan ba matsala ba ce.
ha.quranPronunciation.noFit.too-short: Hakan ya yi gajere da yawa don bi. Karanta dukan ayar, sannan ka taɓa An gama.
ha.quranPronunciation.noFit.different-passa: Ba a iya bin wannan aya ba. Tabbatar ita ce ayar da ke kan allo kuma ka sake gwadawa.
ha.quranPronunciation.noFit.too-many-flags: Ba a iya bin wannan aya a bayyane ba. Sake gwadawa a wuri mafi shiru, kusa da wayar kaɗan.
ha.quranPronunciation.noFit.no-text: Ba za a iya duba wannan aya da mai saurare da aka shigar ba tukuna.
ha.quranPronunciation.calibrate.cta: Karanta aya ɗaya don daidaitawa da muryarka
ha.quranPronunciation.calibrate.intro: Ana daidaitawa: karanta wannan aya kamar yadda kake yi kullum, sannan ka taɓa An gama. Wannan yana daidaita yadda dubawar ke yin taka-tsantsan a wannan na'urar kawai.
ha.quranPronunciation.calibrate.saved: An daidaita don wannan na'urar. Dubawarka ta gaba za ta yi amfani da shi.
ha.quranPronunciation.calibrate.not-enough: Hakan bai isa don daidaitawa ba. Gwada aya mai ɗan tsayi.
ha.quranPronunciation.calibrate.no-fit: Ba a iya bin wannan karatun ba, don haka ba a adana komai ba. Sake gwadawa.
ha.quranPronunciation.calibrate.error: Daidaitawa ba ta ƙare ba. Ba a adana komai ba.
ha.quranPronunciation.model.title: Sauke mai saurare
ha.quranPronunciation.model.body: Duba furuci yana amfani da mai saurare a na'ura (kusan {{size}} MB, ana raba shi da aikin karatun Alƙur'ani da tasbihi ba tare da hannu ba). Ana ba da shawarar Wi-Fi.
ha.quranPronunciation.model.otherEngine: Duba furuci yana buƙatar mai saurare na FastConformer. Sauke shi yana maye gurbin mai sauraren aikinka na yanzu; aikin yana ci gaba da aiki da shi.
ha.quranPronunciation.copy.tartil: Ka ɗauki lokacinka — karanta da tartil a natse.
ha.quranPronunciation.copy.effort: Karatu da ƙoƙari ma yana da lada: wanda ke samun Alƙur'ani da wahala kuma yana ci gaba yana da lada biyu.
ha.quranPronunciation.copy.teacher: Wannan taimako ne na aiki, ba hukunci kan karatunka ba. Duba karatunka tare da malami ƙwararre.
ha.quranPronunciation.summary.title: Karatunka
ha.quranPronunciation.summary.listenAgainTi: Kalmomin da za a sake saurare
ha.quranPronunciation.summary.nothingFlagge: Babu kalmomin da za a sake saurare a wannan karon.
ha.quranPronunciation.summary.feedsCoaching: Za a yi amfani da waɗannan kalmomi a matsayin misalai a horon tajwidinka. Za ka iya kashe wannan a Saituna › Alƙur'ani › Aiki.
ha.quranPronunciation.summary.feedOff: Ƙara waɗannan kalmomi ga horon tajwidi a kashe yake a Saituna › Alƙur'ani › Aiki.

ha.quranPronunciation.settings.calibrationR: Sake saita daidaitawar furuci a wannan na'urar?
ha.quranPronunciation.introSkipped: Karanta ayar da ke kan allo da ƙarfi, sannan ka taɓa An gama. Kalmomin da suka yi kamar an tsallake su ko ba su bayyana ba ana yi musu alama don ka sake saurarensu. Komai yana zama a na'urarka.
ha.tajweedCoaching.title: Yi aikin waɗannan sautuka
ha.tajweedCoaching.intro: Gajeren tsari da aka gina daga aikin karatun Alƙur'ani naka. Yana zaɓar sautukan tajwidi da ke bayyana a ayoyin da kake aiki a kansu kuma yana amfani da kalmomi daga karatunka a matsayin misalai.
ha.tajweedCoaching.honesty: Wannan tsari ba hukunci ba ne kan tajwidinka: ya fito ne daga kalmomin da mai saurare ya ce ka sake gwadawa, kuma manhajar ba za ta iya duba tajwidi a cikin aya ba. Atisayen sauti suna sauraron sauti ɗaya a kalma ɗaya, kuma inda aka auna cewa dubawar tana aiki kawai. Malami ƙwararre shi ne mafi kyawun jagora.
ha.tajweedCoaching.tvReadOnly: Aiki yana buƙatar makirufo, don haka yana samuwa a wayarka, kwamfutar hannu ko kwamfuta. Har yanzu za ka iya karanta dokokin kuma ka saurari kalmomin a nan.
ha.tajweedCoaching.summaryIntro: Daga ayoyin da ka yi aiki a kansu yanzu.
ha.tajweedCoaching.privacy: Ana lissafa tsarinka a wannan na'urar. Sautin karatunka ba ya taɓa barin ta.
ha.tajweedCoaching.empty.offline: Haɗa da intanet sau ɗaya domin manhajar ta samo alamomin tajwidi na ayoyinka. Bayan haka, tana aiki ba tare da intanet ba.
ha.tajweedCoaching.empty.nothing: Ayoyin da ka yi aiki a kansu kwanan nan ba su ƙunshi sautin da za a horar ba tukuna. Ci gaba da aiki kuma tsarin zai girma.
ha.tajweedCoaching.empty.noPractice: Yi aikin 'yan ayoyi a aikin karatun Alƙur'ani kuma tsarin horonka zai bayyana a nan.
ha.tajweedCoaching.plan.includesDrill: Waɗannan ayoyi sun ƙunshi {{rule}} — mu yi aikinsa da kalmomi daga karatunka.
ha.tajweedCoaching.plan.includesListen: Waɗannan ayoyi sun ƙunshi {{rule}} — saurari mai karatu kuma ka maimaita bayansa da kalmomi daga karatunka.

ha.tajweedCoaching.word.body: Wannan kalma tana da {{rule}} — saurari mai karatu kuma ka sake gwadawa.
ha.tajweedCoaching.word.fromCheck: Daga duba furucinka. Yana nufin kalmar ba ta bayyana ga mai saurare ba, ba wai an karya doka ba.

ha.tajweedCoaching.evidence.twoRewards: Lada biyu ga wanda ke karatu da wahala — Riyad as-Salihin 315 (Bukhari da Muslim)
